section.codeblock:
Deploy the web application to the staging environment for QA testing.

Build artifact is available in the artifact repository and environment variables are configured.

Download the build artifact from the artifact repository.

Artifact webapp-2.1.0.zip is downloaded to the local workspace.

Unzip the artifact and run the deployment script: ./deploy.sh staging.

Deployment script completes without errors.

The web application is accessible at https://staging.example.com and health checks return 200 OK.
section.p: Result: Put the outcome, verification steps, and what success looks like in the <result> element so users and automation can quickly confirm completion.
